_comment: Add this 'hooks' block to ~/.claude/settings.json (or your project .claude/settings.json) to auto-trigger save-on-stop when a Claude Code session ends. This runs the skill before the session is torn down.
_install: cp skills/save-on-stop into ~/.claude/skills/, then merge the 'hooks' key below into your settings.json.

hooks.prompt: Use the save-on-stop skill to capture this session into Graphory. Skip if the session was trivial (under 10 substantive turns and no decisions or code changes). If you save, write a one-line confirmation; otherwise stay silent.

_notes: The 'Stop' event fires when Claude Code is about to exit the current session.
The 'prompt' hook lets the model itself decide whether the session is worth saving - this avoids spamming Graphory with throwaway one-liners.

If you want unconditional saves, replace the prompt with a direct tool-call hook that invokes save_message with a templated body. See https://docs.anthropic.com/claude-code/hooks for the full hook reference.
The skill itself (skills/save-on-stop/SKILL.md) describes the call shape - the Stop hook only needs to delegate to the skill, not reimplement it.
